Rewards > drop downs. Sub-state driven with frame-verify-steps exit-0 and inventoried numerically: the sort dropdown opens with exactly 3 real options Newest, Closing soonest, Highest Yes price, with aria-selected true on Newest. No surplus options, no dead entries. Honours designer note 3650-63719 that the control is now usable

breaking sort mode. src/lib/predict/sortModes.ts marks breaking permanently unavailable by design: it needs a probability-history SOURCE that does not exist, so the tab renders in place but disabled with the reason on title. Structural parity only; the frame's active-breaking state is unreachable until price history is recorded

politics category view. Verified numerically that clicking Politics moves aria-pressed and re-filters, and that the category row is computed from PREDICT_CATEGORIES so it is open-ended per designer note 3553-5509. The populated card grid could not be compared, feed empty locally

breaking > sample market 2 detail. /predict/market/binary/1 renders exit-0 but resolves to the predict-detail-missing state; the detail frame needs a real indexed market, which this environment has none of
new sort mode. Available only when a venue reports createdAt; on the local feed no market does, so the tab renders disabled with its reason. Cannot verify the active-new ordering without markets

Rewards > Open orders. Tab switch driven and inventoried numerically: aria-selected moves to Open orders and the panel renders its own Figma column set Market, Filled, Total, Expiration, Action plus an explicit no-open-orders state explaining both venues are constant-product AMMs with no resting-order book. No fabricated order rows, no surplus controls
sports category view of /predict/all. Sports tab present and filterable; populated grid unverifiable on an empty feed
